title: Molecular Titration Lab
description: A virtual titration lab where the WaterBottle serves as a burette dispensing reagent into a ShaderBall acting as a reaction flask. The user must carefully titrate an acid-base solution by controlling pour rate, temperature, and catalyst additions while obeying conservation of mass, tracking pH changes in real-time, and using undo/redo to correct overshoots toward the equivalence point.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 with GLTFLoader and OrbitControls from CDN. Load WaterBottle.glb positioned above-right as a tilting burette and ShaderBall.glb centered below as a spherical reaction flask. Set up a PerspectiveCamera at (0,3,6) looking at origin, with ambient light (0.4) and two directional lights for lab atmosphere. Add a subtle grid floor and a dark gradient background. The ShaderBall material color must dynamically shift from red (pH 1, acidic) through green (pH 7, neutral) to blue (pH 14, basic) based on current pH state. Implement these interactions requiring 10-14 steps total: (1) A 'Pour' button tilts the WaterBottle with a tween animation and spawns particle droplets falling into the flask, each pour adds 5mL of NaOH and changes pH according to a simplified titration curve. (2) A temperature slider (20-80°C) affects reaction rate, shown as particle agitation speed inside the flask. (3) A 'Add Catalyst' toggle drops a small glowing sphere into the flask, doubling pH change per pour. (4) Conservation of mass: display total volume in flask (starts at 50mL HCl) and remaining in burette (starts at 50mL NaOH). Volume poured from burette must equal volume gained in flask. Burette empties visually. (5) A full undo/redo stack (Ctrl+Z/Ctrl+Y and buttons) that reverts each pour, catalyst toggle, or temperature change, restoring all coupled state: pH, color, volumes, particle count, and temperature. (6) A real-time HUD panel showing pH (2 decimals), flask volume, burette remaining, temperature, catalyst status, and step count. (7) When pH reaches 6.8-7.2, flash a 'Equivalence Point Reached' success banner with confetti particles. (8) If burette empties before equivalence, show a warning. All state changes must be coupled: undoing a catalyst addition must also revert any pours done while catalyst was active. Use requestAnimationFrame for particle animation and flask color interpolation.
